desc: TAPCO Universal Cleaning Kit - The TAPCO Universal Cleaning Kit is good on all handguns, rifle & shotguns. A great item to add to your range bag and gun cabinet. It has the ability to clean an array of firearms from .22 Cal - 12 GA. *Includes: Rigid Black Steel Rods, 30in Length with Swivel Handle, Rod Accessory Adaptor to accept #8-32 Threads, Double End Nylon Bristle Gun Brush, Black Steel Patch Holder, Aluminum Shotgun Adaptor, Slotted Shotgun Patch Holder, Muzzle Guard, 2oz CLP, Silicone Cloth, Cotton Cleaning Patches
